continuity.characterRule: Use only approved locked V5 character identities. Do not redesign face, hair, age, wardrobe identity, or body proportions between shots.
continuity.vehicleRule: Preserve the same hero vehicle and Indonesian right-hand-drive interior geometry in every car shot.
continuity.environmentRule: Preserve Jakarta/Kuningan/Casablanca geography, wet-road continuity, night lighting progression, and established environment IDs.
continuity.storyClockRule: Visual time progression must follow each shot's storyClock. Signature supernatural transition begins at exactly 03:13.
continuity.horrorRule: H0 must remain natural; H1 subtle anomaly; H2 oppressive supernatural presence without full reveal; H3 controlled reveal. Do not introduce extra ghosts or gore not specified by the shot.
continuity.textRule: Any phone/dashboard text explicitly stated in a shot must be legible and exact. Do not invent extra UI copy.
continuity.negativePrompt: wrong face, different actor, duplicate person, extra passenger, extra ghost, inconsistent vehicle interior, left-hand-drive layout, non-Jakarta architecture, daylight, cartoon, illustration, anime, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, unreadable phone UI, random text, watermark, logo, contact sheet, collage

runtime.replacementRule: Approved V5 source replaces runtime file in-place. Runtime URL and database shot ID must not change.
